premises.text: Users hold cash in P2P apps that benefits the apps, not the users, under inflation
premises.evidence_span: peer-to-peer apps that are benefiting from cash balances and earning a return, leaving nothing behind for their users

premises.text: Millennials and Gen Z want wealth growth but lack time and resources to invest
premises.evidence_span: want to earn and grow our wealth, but sometimes just lack the resources, time, or energy or resources to invest

premises.text: Paybacks can be stock picks from the recipient's favorites instead of cash settlement only
premises.evidence_span: Your roommate paying you back rent and Apple stock

premises.text: Backend cash converts to chosen stock only after accept, with cash or switch options
premises.evidence_span: comes out of my account as cash and enters her account as cash on the back end. It only converts to stock once she clicks Accept

premises.text: Beyond consumer P2P, Stacks can plug into rideshare, registries, and business payment platforms
premises.evidence_span: Even businesses will be able to plug into Stacks

premises.text: Partner brokerage coverage makes users feel safe investing long-term
premises.evidence_span: we've got you covered. We cover up to 250K of user cash balances and 500K of portfolio investments

value.text: Create limitless value by turning payments into investments
value.evidence_span: create limitless value with every single transaction

secondary_value.text: Contribute to peers' wealth visibly as it grows
secondary_value.evidence_span: contribute to your peers' wealth and actually see it grow as well

causal_links.evidence_span: turn every payment into an investment
incorporating investments into your payments platform

notes: Business/rideshare plug-in coded as a separately revisable distribution module this run because speaker frames it as going beyond P2P. Social feed folded into product value rather than its own premise.
